# Eazybe — Full Documentation for AI Systems

> Powering sales conversations across WhatsApp and calls. Eazybe connects your team's personal WhatsApp numbers, WhatsApp groups and calls to your CRM, and lets AI handle qualification and follow-ups. Works on Personal WhatsApp, the Business app and the API — no migration needed. Trusted by 2,000+ sales teams in 40+ countries.

## What Eazybe Does

Eazybe is a Chrome extension, Android app ([Eazybe on Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.eazybe.workspace)) and SaaS platform for teams that sell over WhatsApp and the phone. Most deals die quietly, long before anyone marks them lost: a chat nobody logged, a follow-up nobody sent, and the lead moves on. Eazybe fixes that in four parts of one connected flow, from first message to closed deal (back up every business conversation, reach out, understand, and let AI do the work). Teams usually start with the part where they leak the most deals:

1. **Conversation management** — Auto-sync conversations to your CRM. Your team's personal WhatsApp numbers and your customer WhatsApp groups are connected; chats, files, voice notes and calls land on the right contact and deal.
2. **Outreach** — WhatsApp and calling workflows, connected: broadcast from anywhere (pick contacts from WhatsApp Web, Google Sheets, your CRM or the public API and send one personalised message to all of them) and an auto dialer that works through a call list and saves every call.
3. **Sales intelligence** — AI mines WhatsApp chats and calls for budget, urgency and buying intent, saves them as CRM fields, and alerts the team when a lead is ready to buy.
4. **AI agents** — Every lead answered in seconds, on WhatsApp and on the phone. WhatsApp, Voice and Website agents qualify leads, book meetings and hand over to the right rep.

It also closes three loops sales teams lose money on:

1. **The CRM loop** — Every WhatsApp conversation and call flows into your CRM automatically. No copy-paste, no "I'll log it later", no lost context.
2. **The ad-spend loop** — Click-to-WhatsApp ad clicks get scored for intent in real time. Real buyers go to top closers and high-intent retargeting audiences. Curious clickers get skipped — your ad budget reclaims itself.
3. **The deal-health loop** — Ghosted deals, missed follow-ups, and stalled pipeline get surfaced before they die, so reps intervene with context, not guesswork.

## What Problem Does Eazybe Solve?

### The CRM Blind Spot
90% of customer conversations happen in WhatsApp, but CRMs see none of it. This creates critical business problems:

1. **Zero Visibility**: Deals move in WhatsApp, but CRM shows stale data. Sales managers can't see response times, unreplied chats, or which deals are going cold.

2. **Hot Deals Slip Away**: A lead asks for pricing on WhatsApp. No one replies for 6 hours. By the time someone notices, the lead has signed with a competitor. There was no system to flag the delay.

3. **Ghosted Clients Stay Hidden**: Stalled deals, escalation requests, and clients who stopped responding are buried in individual chat threads with no way to filter or surface them.

4. **Employee Exit = Data Walkout**: When a sales rep leaves, years of customer conversations leave with them. No backup, no handover. The next rep starts from zero.

5. **Wasted Ad Spend**: Click-to-WhatsApp ads bring in leads — but you pay the same for someone curious and someone ready to buy. Without an intent signal flowing back to Meta and Google, your retargeting audience keeps including tire-kickers and your cost per real buyer keeps rising.

### How Eazybe Solves It
Eazybe sits on top of the WhatsApp your team already uses (via the Chrome extension on WhatsApp Web and the Android app) and connects it, along with calls, to your CRM and ad platforms. Every message and call is captured, synced, and made actionable by AI agents that work across WhatsApp, the phone and your website.

Your CRM only knows what reps remember to type in. Connect WhatsApp, and client chats and calls land on the right contact with fields filled in. No new phones, nothing to migrate: it works with the CRM you already pay for (HubSpot, Salesforce, Zoho CRM, Pipedrive, Odoo, Bitrix24, LeadSquared, Freshworks and more).

Reply-time alerts keep hot deals from slipping: if nobody replies to a customer within the SLA (for example 30 minutes), Eazybe sends a WhatsApp message to the deal owner.

## AI Agents

The agents share the same context engine and CRM record, so a deal that starts in qualification never loses its history when it moves to close. They work with every WhatsApp number — Personal, Business, and API.

### WhatsApp AI Agent
Answers leads on WhatsApp when the team can't, 24/7 and in the customer's language. It reads past chats and deal details in the CRM, asks what the lead needs and books a call with a rep. When the lead is ready to talk, it passes the chat to the right person on the team.

### Voice AI Agent
Phones leads on its own, holds a real conversation, books meetings and saves the transcript for the team. Calls new leads within seconds while they are still interested, handles call-backs, renewals and after-hours enquiries, and logs the outcome and next step in the CRM. Available on the Custom AI plan.

### Website Agent
Chats with website visitors ("Ask us anything"), creates the contact and deal in the CRM, and continues the conversation on the visitor's WhatsApp number.

### CRM Sync Agent
Auto-logs every WhatsApp chat to your CRM in real time. Bi-directional sync: messages flow from WhatsApp to CRM, CRM actions can trigger WhatsApp messages. The foundation every other agent builds on.

### CTWA Agent (Click-to-WhatsApp Ads)
The intent-scoring agent that closes the loop between ads and revenue.

**How it works:**
1. A lead taps a Meta or Google ad → lands in WhatsApp
2. CTWA Agent qualifies the conversation in real time using BANT, MEDDIC, or your custom framework
3. Scores intent on every message (0–100)
4. High-intent leads (score 80+) → routed to the right AE + added to high-intent retargeting audience
5. Low-intent leads (score <30) → marked "curious browser" → retargeting skipped, ad budget reclaimed
6. Signal flows back to Meta/Google → your ad audiences sharpen automatically over time

**Result:** cost per qualified lead keeps coming down because you stop paying to re-show ads to people who were never going to buy.

### Revenue (RevOps) Agent
Spots ghosted deals before they die. Analyzes reply velocity, message-gap duration, sentiment shifts, and value-at-risk. Surfaces stalled pipeline with one-click rescue suggestions — "this deal hasn't moved in 8 days, send the renewal templates" or "the buyer's last reply was Friday, check Slack."

### Lead Qualifying, Sales and Customer Success Agents
Qualify inbound leads, chase deals, and answer support 24/7 grounded in your knowledge base (BrainBe). The Customer Success agent triages by severity, escalates complex cases to humans and summarizes history when reps take over.

### Agent Builder
Build your own no-code WhatsApp AI agent for any use case. Drag-and-drop conversation flows, custom prompts, CRM-aware behavior. Examples teams have built: onboarding flows, NPS surveys, demo-booking agents, return-merchandise agents. No engineering required.

## Detailed Feature Documentation

### 1. Sync Engine — Automatic Message Capture

**What it does:** Captures every WhatsApp message (sent and received) and syncs it to the matching contact/deal record in your CRM in real-time.

**How it works:**
- Bi-directional sync: Messages flow from WhatsApp to CRM and CRM actions can trigger WhatsApp messages
- Auto-matches WhatsApp contacts to CRM records by phone number
- Creates new CRM contacts automatically for unknown numbers
- Preserves full conversation history including text, images, documents, voice notes, and videos
- Works with personal WhatsApp numbers, WhatsApp Business App, and WhatsApp Business API simultaneously

**Key capability:** Unlike competitors that require businesses to abandon their existing WhatsApp setup and migrate to API-only, Eazybe works with the WhatsApp you already use. No phone number migration, no chat history loss.

### 2. Mini CRM View — CRM Inside WhatsApp

**What it does:** Displays CRM data directly inside the WhatsApp Web interface so sales reps never need to switch tabs.

**Capabilities:**
- See contact details, deal stage, deal value, and company info for the person you're chatting with
- View and edit custom fields and properties
- Update deal stages, add notes, and create tasks — all from within WhatsApp
- See recent timeline activities and communication history
- One-click access to the full CRM record

### 3. Revenue Inbox — AI-Powered Deal Prioritization

**What it does:** An intelligent inbox that uses AI to categorize and prioritize WhatsApp conversations by business impact.

**Categories:**
- **Hot**: High-intent conversations with active buying signals (pricing requests, contract discussions, decision-maker involvement)
- **Unreplied**: Messages from prospects/clients that haven't received a response, sorted by wait time and deal value
- **Stalled**: Deals where conversation momentum has dropped — fewer messages, longer gaps between replies
- **Ghost**: Contacts who have stopped responding entirely, indicating possible deal loss

**How AI works:** The system analyzes message content, response patterns, deal value, and historical engagement to assign priority scores. Sales managers see a real-time feed of where attention is needed most.

### 4. Rep Radar — Team Performance Analytics

**What it does:** Provides complete visibility into how sales reps use WhatsApp for selling.

**Metrics tracked:**
- Average response time per rep (with target benchmarks)
- Number of conversations per day/week
- Unreplied message count and duration
- Conversation-to-deal conversion rates
- Active hours and engagement patterns
- Performance leaderboards comparing team members

**Use case:** Sales managers use Rep Radar to identify coaching opportunities, recognize top performers, and ensure SLA compliance on response times.

### 5. WhatsApp Copilot — AI Sales Assistant

**What it does:** An AI assistant that helps sales reps sell more effectively through WhatsApp.

**Capabilities:**
- **Smart Reply Suggestions**: AI analyzes the conversation context and suggests appropriate responses
- **Conversation Summaries**: Get a quick AI-generated summary of any conversation — useful for handovers or manager reviews
- **Next-Best-Action Prompts**: AI recommends what to do next (send proposal, schedule demo, follow up on objection)
- **Natural Language CRM Updates**: Type commands like "Update James's deal to $15,000 and move to negotiation" and the AI executes the CRM update

### 6. Workflow Automations — CRM-Triggered WhatsApp Messages

**What it does:** Automatically sends WhatsApp messages when specific CRM events occur.

**Examples:**
- When a deal hasn't received a reply in 24 hours → Send a follow-up WhatsApp message
- When a new lead is created in CRM → Send a welcome message via WhatsApp
- When a deal moves to "Proposal Sent" stage → Schedule a check-in message for 3 days later
- When a form is submitted on the website → Send a WhatsApp confirmation

**Performance:** Automated follow-ups achieve 92% reply rates compared to email's typical 15-25%.

### 7. Cloud Backup — Data Protection

**What it does:** Continuously backs up all WhatsApp conversations to secure cloud storage.

**Why it matters:** When a sales rep leaves the company, their WhatsApp conversations typically go with them. Cloud Backup ensures:
- Complete conversation history is preserved regardless of employee turnover
- New reps can access full client communication history
- Business continuity is maintained
- Compliance requirements for communication archival are met

### 8. Team Inbox — Collaborative WhatsApp Management

**What it does:** Allows multiple team members to view, manage, and respond to WhatsApp conversations from a shared interface.

**Capabilities:**
- Conversation assignment and routing
- Internal notes and tags on conversations
- Transfer conversations between team members
- Supervisor monitoring and live assist

### 9. WhatsApp Groups in the CRM

**What it does:** Links customer WhatsApp groups to CRM records, so group conversations (e.g. a "Fleet Ops × Your company" deal group) are logged and visible to the whole account team, not just the rep in the group.

### 10. Call Tracking, Auto Dialer and Voice Numbers

**Call tracking:** Logs every call's time, length and outcome in the CRM. Works with SIM calls on Android and virtual calls; every call is saved beside the customer's WhatsApp chats.

**Auto dialer:** Pick a call list from WhatsApp Web, Google Sheets, your CRM (HubSpot, Salesforce, Zoho, Eazybe CRM or your Workspace) or the public API and press start. Eazybe calls your customers, rings the next number as soon as a call ends, shows customers a local number from their own country, and saves each recording and outcome back to the contact with the next step set.

**Voice numbers:** Buy a voice number from Eazybe and use one business line for voice calls, SMS, the WhatsApp Business app and the WhatsApp API. Available in the US, Canada and Puerto Rico; Eazybe handles number verification, and the number (and customer history) stays with the company when a rep leaves. Offered as an optional add-on on every plan.

### 11. Sales Intelligence

**What it does:** AI goes through WhatsApp chats and calls, picks out details like budget, urgency and buying intent, and saves them as fields in the CRM ("intelligence-led CRM properties"). Teams filter hot leads and get alerts when someone is ready to buy.

### 12. Outreach: Broadcast and WhatsApp Cloud API

- **Broadcast from anywhere:** pick your contacts, write one message and send it to all of them in one tap; every customer gets it on WhatsApp with their own name in it. Contacts can come from a WhatsApp Web label (e.g. "Hot leads"), an uploaded Google Sheet, any HubSpot, Salesforce or Zoho list, or the public API (trigger broadcasts from your own app or website). Large templated campaigns run on the official WhatsApp Cloud API.
- **Coexistence:** Eazybe can set up the Cloud API on an existing WhatsApp Business number without losing the app or chat history.
- **Templates:** approved message templates for marketing, utility and authentication messages.
- The Cloud API is only needed for things like large broadcasts; most of Eazybe works with the number a rep already has.

### 13. Privacy Controls

Reps won't use a tool that pulls in their personal WhatsApp. With Eazybe, personal and private group chats never sync. Only the business chats you select reach your CRM, and admins decide who sees them (access levels). Eazybe carries SOC 2 Type II, GDPR, CCPA and PCI DSS badges for IT and legal review. When a rep leaves, their chats, files and call history stay with the customer record for the next rep, while they keep their own number.

### 14. Mobile App

The Eazybe Android app is available on Google Play under the name "Eazybe": https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.eazybe.workspace

## CRM Integration Details

### HubSpot Integration
- **Sync scope:** Contacts, Companies, Deals, Tickets
- **Message logging:** All WhatsApp messages appear as timeline activities on the corresponding HubSpot record
- **Automation:** Trigger WhatsApp messages from HubSpot Workflows
- **Reporting:** WhatsApp conversation metrics available in HubSpot reporting dashboards
- **Custom properties:** Map WhatsApp data to custom HubSpot properties
- **Setup time:** Under 30 minutes via Chrome extension

### Salesforce Integration
- **Sync scope:** Leads, Contacts, Accounts, Opportunities
- **Message logging:** WhatsApp messages logged as Activities on Salesforce records
- **Automation:** Integrate with Salesforce Flows for triggered WhatsApp messaging
- **Custom objects:** Map WhatsApp data to custom Salesforce objects
- **Setup time:** Under 30 minutes

### Zoho CRM Integration
- **Sync scope:** Leads, Contacts, Deals, Accounts
- **AI agents:** Use Zoho-integrated AI agents for automated WhatsApp responses
- **Automation:** Connect with Zoho Workflows and Blueprints
- **Setup time:** Under 30 minutes

### Other Supported CRMs
- **Pipedrive:** Deals, Contacts, Activities sync
- **Odoo:** CRM sync
- **Bitrix24:** CRM module integration
- **LeadSquared:** Lead capture and activity tracking
- **Freshworks:** Freshdesk tickets and Freshsales contacts
- **Google Sheets:** Custom data export and reporting
- **Webhooks and Eazybe API:** Universal integration endpoint for almost any other tool

| CRM bi-directional sync | Limited | Full |
| AI-powered deal prioritization | Rare | Built-in |
| Team performance analytics | Basic | Advanced (Rep Radar) |

### Key Differentiator
Eazybe is the only solution that works across all three WhatsApp types (personal, Business App, and Business API) simultaneously, with full CRM integration and AI capabilities. Competitors force businesses to abandon their existing WhatsApp setup and migrate entirely to the API, losing chat history and requiring technical implementation.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Who is Eazybe?**
Think of Eazybe as the bridge between WhatsApp and your CRM. It's a WhatsApp CRM integration for teams that sell over chats and calls, giving managers full visibility while AI takes care of replies and follow-ups.

**How does Eazybe sync WhatsApp chats?**
Reps keep their own number and phone, and their business chats flow into a shared team inbox and your CRM through WhatsApp CRM sync. Files, voice notes and calls come along too, so the CRM fills itself in while reps get on with selling.

**Which CRMs does Eazybe support?**
Ready-made connections for HubSpot, Salesforce, Zoho CRM, Pipedrive, Odoo, Bitrix24, LeadSquared, Freshworks and Google Sheets. For anything else, the Eazybe API and webhooks plug into almost any tool.

**What is WhatsApp sales intelligence in Eazybe?**
AI goes through your WhatsApp chats and calls, picks out details like budget, urgency and buying intent, and saves them as fields in your CRM. Your team can filter hot leads and get alerts when someone is ready to buy.

**What does the WhatsApp AI agent do?**
It answers your leads on WhatsApp when your team can't. It looks at past chats and deal details in your CRM, asks what they need and books a call with your rep. When the lead is ready to talk, it passes the chat to the right person.

**Does Eazybe track phone calls?**
Yes. Call tracking logs every call's time, length and outcome in your CRM, working with SIM calls on Android and virtual calls. Reps can run through call lists with bulk dialling, and Voice AI can phone leads on its own, hold a real conversation, book meetings and save the transcript for your team.

**Can Eazybe send automatic follow-ups?**
Yes, through CRM workflows. If a quote gets no reply in three days, for example, an automated WhatsApp follow-up goes out from the rep's own number and stops as soon as the customer writes back.

**Is the WhatsApp Business API required?**
No, most of Eazybe works with the number you already have. The WhatsApp Cloud API only comes into play for things like large broadcasts with approved templates, and Eazybe can set it up on your existing number without touching your app or chat history.

**Is my data safe with Eazybe?**
Eazybe only syncs the business chats you pick, so personal conversations stay personal, and access controls decide who sees what. When a rep leaves, their chats, files and call history stay with the customer record for the next rep, while they keep their own number.

**Does Eazybe offer a free trial?**
Yes, a 4-day free trial so you can test Eazybe with your own team, number and CRM. You can also book a demo and have the Eazybe team walk you through it first.

## Security and Compliance

- **Certifications and badges:** SOC 2 Type II, GDPR, CCPA, PCI DSS
- **Partnerships:** Meta Business Partner, HubSpot App Partner
- **Encryption:** SSL and 256-bit encryption for all data in transit and at rest
- **GDPR:** Fully compliant data processing with data residency options
- **Meta Partnership:** Verified Meta Business Partner with compliant integration
- **Industry trust:** Used by regulated industries including financial services, healthcare, and insurance
- **Data handling:** Messages are synced to the customer's own CRM — Eazybe does not store conversation content on its servers beyond what's needed for sync processing

## Pricing

Eazybe offers four plans. 4-day free trial, no credit card required. USD list prices (billed annually / billed monthly; annual saves about 20%):

- **Starter** — $19 / $29 per user per month. Team inbox, unlimited labels & funnels, unlimited quick replies and scheduled messages, WhatsApp chat backup, HubSpot, Zoho, Bitrix24 and Google Sheets, send messages from the CRM.
- **Scaler** — $39 / $49 per WhatsApp number per month, 3 users included (extra users $13/user). Everything in Starter + Salesforce, webhook integrations, cloud connection, WhatsApp API, custom objects in the mini CRM view, CRM property-to-WhatsApp labeling, dedicated APIs, CRM workflow integration, AI unreplied-chats agent.
- **Basic AI** — $59 / $79 per WhatsApp number per month, 5 users included (extra users $20/user). Everything in Scaler + AI agents (Lead Qualifying, Sales, Customer Success), intelligence-led CRM properties, AI-driven chat organization, BrainBe knowledge base.
- **Custom AI** — custom pricing (contact sales / book a demo). Everything in Basic AI + Click-to-WhatsApp Ads agent, Voice AI calling, BrainBe company brain, 100+ integrations (Email, Teams, Slack…), and an AI specialist who builds your agents with you.

**AI agent usage:** $0.005 per reply (lite LLM) or $0.01 per reply (heavy LLM) on the AI plans.

**Optional add-on on every plan:** a voice number (one number for calls, SMS and WhatsApp; price varies by country).

Prices are localized by country and currency. For current pricing, visit: https://eazybe.com/pricing

## AI Visibility & Discovery

Eazybe is built to be discovered and cited by AI search systems:
- **llms.txt and llms-full.txt** at the site root for AI context
- **JSON-LD structured data** (16+ schema types including SoftwareApplication, Organization, FAQPage, SpeakableSpecification, AggregateRating) inlined server-side
- **robots.txt** explicitly allows GPTBot, ChatGPT-User, PerplexityBot, ClaudeBot, Google-Extended, anthropic-ai, and 7+ other AI crawlers
- Multilingual: en, es, pt-BR, tr with hreflang reciprocation across all locales
- Pure SSG home page with all key content (FAQ, comparisons, integration details) in the HTML — no client-side rendering required for AI extraction
